requiredbulletpoints.bulletpoint: Unity engineer on Wave’s VR social concert platform, building live event systems, performance tools, and backend-integrated client features in a startup environment.

bulletpoints.bulletpoint: Expanded Wave’s DJ Deck performance system, implementing much of its final feature set while collaborating on audio encoding and streaming subsystems. Evolved an early prototype into a production-ready interface used in live VR events.

Founded and led Wave’s Resident DJ Program in its first year, scaling to 12 concurrent DJs and up to 5 weekly VR shows between headline events. Drove feature improvements across DJ Deck, scheduling, and moderation systems.

Contributed to WaveMaker, a live venue creation tool built by a four-engineer team, focusing on UI systems and QA iteration. Helped ship a customization system used to create hundreds to thousands of virtual venues.
Integrated licensed music assets for headline VR concerts, supporting audio processing and live event implementation within Wave’s Unity platform.

Implemented gesture-based and menu-driven friend, block, and mute systems informed by user research and cross-platform safety standards. Partnered with product and UX to improve moderation tooling for live events.

Contributed to an official Wave–Roblox partnership porting the Jauz VR concert to Roblox, implementing gameplay and effects in Lua while adapting to Roblox physics and monetization. Worked with Roblox engineers on encrypted music and limited-access UGC using pre-release tools.
